name: business-central-al
description: Full-lifecycle Cursor plugin for Business Central AL development. End-to-end from new repo through AppSource Go Live: the official Microsoft AL MCP server for the inner dev loop, AL-Go for GitHub workflow dispatch, microsoft/BCApps canonical analyzer rulesets, microsoft/BCQuality structured review (super-skill + 6 leaves, strict JSON contract, layered knowledge with TAG custom-layer pre-seeded), microsoft/BC-Bench's measured-winner ALTest domain-agent prompt for AL test generation (+10.7 pt vs baseline), the BCApps al-docs hierarchical-documentation skill, and a userPromptSubmit hook that auto-surfaces BC project metadata on every prompt. Session-start hook recommends the BC-Bench-measured top models (Claude Opus 4.7, Sonnet 4.6) and warns against gpt-4.1 for AL tasks. 53 slash-invokable skills (40+ inner-loop / lifecycle / quality skills with disable-model-invocation:true, plus 13 agent-decided orchestration skills). BC runtime MCP (Phase 6) remains deferred.
